svg.title: Repeat requests return quickly
svg.desc: Approximately 50 percent of repeat user-model requests return within 0.1 seconds, 80 percent within 10 seconds, and 99 percent within 15 minutes. These are repeat arrivals, not guaranteed prefix-cache hits.

ns2:Work.dc:title: Repeat requests from the same user to the same model return quickly
ns2:Work.dc:description: Reported approximate checkpoints: 50% within 0.1 seconds, 80% within 10 seconds, and 99% within 15 minutes. Source: A Year in LLM Serving, Section 6.2 and Figure 16. These measure repeat arrivals, not confirmed prefix reuse.
